title: overlay-r3/r2/port dc1 + dc2: every DC file convert-dc1 does not reproduce (merged net.bin / menu.bin / modules.bin / medals / looks / scenes / vox* / weapon-* / net-always-loaded / ss-coop-adv-fort / part modules, and 80 conversions + .dci),  rebuilt from provenance recipes; menu.bin gets PS3 1.19's message of the day page (u3fix.exe dc-recipes, dcconv/apply_recipes.cpp, dcconv/menu_pages.cpp)
notes: The cloud merge scripts are lost (dcsynth/dcgraft2/dcmod4/ngconv2/netfix.py: only fragments in the 10-27 transcripts). tools/dcconv/dc-recipes.json.gz records, for each target file, which bytes of the user's PS4 retail / PS3 1.19 module (raw, 32-bit-swapped or 16-bit-swapped) make it up, its pointer slots, and the few bytes no source holds. Sources are sha256-checked; each output must hit the reference sha256 or it is not written. Final (reference) states: the session dctools steps afterwards find their changes present and do nothing. Verified 2026-11-05 end to end (rebuild_overlays --only convert-dc1,dc-recipes,enemy-stall-option-defaults,coop-audit-option-defaults on D:): 302 of the 303 dc1/dc2 manifest files sha256-identical, the 303rd is skel-retargets.bin (airport-igc3); 5947 literal bytes in 8.15 MB rebuilt. Since 2026-11-13 C++ (u3fix.exe dc-recipes): all 161 recipes rebuild as before (156 at the recorded sha256, 5 net.bin variants from a newer server net18.bin), no Python. Since 1.32.3 (owner's decision 2026-11-24, ps3net SPEC-families2 NP-R5): overlay-r3 menu.bin also gets PAGE_MULTIPLAYER_MOTD (0xd6f98d11; element BUTTON_MULTIPLAYER_MOTD_OK 0xab58f9da; leave button BUTTON_MULTIPLAYER_LEAVE_MULTIPLAYER 0xafb7834c) converted from the player's PS3 1.19 menu.bin (dlc-patch18) while the file is rebuilt (menu_pages.cpp: record, element group, element and strings appended, page table rebuilt with the page last, append-only), and overlay-r3 modules.bin's menu size word follows; these two are compared by their rebuilt bytes, not the recorded sha256. The page layouts were checked against the 122 pages both games have. The helper shows the page and fills its text.
